meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 AI 生成的冗余代码清理干净,再用回归测试确保功能没被改坏
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想清理留下的坏味道又怕改坏功能
copy.tagline_en: Clean up redundant AI-written code, then run regression tests to confirm nothing broke
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI often and want to remove the resulting smells without breaking things

howto.what: 先为改动过的文件补上回归测试锁住现有行为,再按九类清单清理 AI 代码气味(冗余注释、过度防御、死代码等),最后跑质量门禁复核,不通过就回退或直接改。
howto.when: 当用户要求清理、deslop 或移除最近改动里的 AI-slop 模式时触发。默认范围是分支相对 merge-base main 的差异,也可由调用方传入具体文件列表。

say.text: 帮我把当前分支的改动 deslop 一下
say.note: 会先补回归测试锁行为再清理

say.text: 清理 src/foo.py 里的 AI 代码气味
say.note: 这个文件成为清理范围

say.text: 把这些改动里多余的注释和死代码清掉
say.note: 按死代码、注释等类别处理

howto.what_en: It first adds regression tests to lock existing behavior, then runs a categorized cleanup of AI-generated code smells (obvious comments, over-defensive code, dead code, etc.), then verifies with quality gates and reverts if that fails.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes; default scope is the branch diff vs merge-base main, or a given file list.

say_en.text: Deslop the changes on my current branch
say_en.note: Adds regression tests first, then cleans

say_en.text: Clean up the AI code smells in src/foo.py
say_en.note: That file becomes the cleanup scope

say_en.text: Remove the extra comments and dead code from these changes
say_en.note: Handled by category, e.g. dead code, comments
